The '''Heavy Lightning Rifle''' was a custom-crafted weapon that emitted an intense, cohesive blast of electrical energy. More powerful and more accurate than the basic [[Lightning Rifle]], it was favored by [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]].<ref name="TCSWE" />
